alt_text: Monthly time series show activity frequency and distance for walking, Mall skating, PT skating, and FNS/SNS skating. Missing months are omitted rather than plotted as zero.
interpretation: Longitudinal WHOOP and Strava records corroborate sustained skating activity across time alongside the controlled Mobility Perturbation & Recovery Experiment.
limitations: Sample counts, date coverage, source scope, missingness, and measurement availability accompany each scientific result.
long_description: Longitudinal WHOOP and Strava records corroborate sustained skating activity across time alongside the controlled Mobility Perturbation & Recovery Experiment. Missing months are not zero-filled. Pending weekly Strava binding is a coverage state, not data loss. Sample counts, date coverage, source scope, missingness, and measurement availability accompany each scientific result.
qualifications: Pending weekly Strava binding is a coverage state, not data loss.
title: Longitudinal activity and useful distance
